question:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

Opposing or taking arms against a government or ruler.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Rebel**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Among the given options, the correct word to substitute the given phrase is option 4.**

 
 
• **The word "rebel" means opposing or taking arms against a government or ruler.** (बागी)
 
• It can be used as a noun (e.g. "The rebels launched an attack on the capital.") or a verb (e.g. "The citizens rebelled against the new tax law.").
 
• The word has a negative connotation and implies disobedience or defiance.
 
 
 
• Therefore, option 4 "rebel" can substitute the given group of words.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "Participant", refers to someone who is involved in an activity or event, but does not necessarily imply opposition or conflict.(प्रतिभागी)
 
• Option 2, "Rubel", is a name and has no relation to the given definition. It is a monetary unit of Belarus and Russia.
 
• Option 3, "Volunteer", refers to someone who offers to do something without being forced or paid, but again does not necessarily imply opposition to a government or ruler.(स्वयंसेवक)
